## The Stock Portfolios Data

This project uses Yahoo finance data on the top US stock indexes, Treasury Bill Yield indexes, and individual stocks in the S&P 500, retrieved with the tidyquant package. This dataset filters data only for the S&P 500.

### Variables: `sp500.csv`

`symbol` : Stock symbol

`date` : Trading day

`event` : Variable indicating whether the reported price is the opening, highest, lowest, closing, or adjusted price

`price` : Traded price of the stock on the date (dollars)
